options.name: progression_balancing
options.description:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: accessibility
options.description:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: whitePowerupItemWeight
options.description: When you receive a powerup item, the weight of this powerup being white

options.name: bluePowerupItemWeight
options.description: When you receive a powerup item, the weight of this powerup being blue

options.name: orangePowerupItemWeight
options.description: When you receive a powerup item, the weight of this powerup being orange

options.name: nbPowerupRegions
options.description:
How many regions to create in logic and put powerups pickup locations into
The logic uses multiple regions in order to force late powerups locations (example, White Powerup 87) to be in later spheres (so that one of your friends doesn't need it to enter their sphere 2 for example)
Higher values means that it's less likely for powerups locations you will get pretty late to contain items needed earlier

options.name: whitePerRegion
options.display_name: Number Of White Powerup Location Per Region
options.description:
How many white powerup pickup location to put in each region
Note that the total ammount of white powerups you will need to pickup to get the whole location pool is Number Of Regions * Number Of Location Per Region
White powerup locations picked up after that won't give you anything

options.name: bluePerRegion
options.display_name: Number Of Blue Powerup Location Per Region
options.description: Same as above but for the blue powerup locations

options.name: orangePerRegion
options.display_name: Number Of Orange Powerup Location Per Region
options.description: Same as above but for the orange powerup locations

options.name: includeExoticArmors
options.description: Wether to add crafting Wolfskin armor and Chunkium armor as locations

options.name: includeLegendaryWeapons
options.description:
Wether to add crafting legendary weapons as locations
These are the Wyvern Dagger, Gronk's Sword, Chunky Hammer, Night Blade, Chiefs Spear and Ancient Bow

options.name: allowLootAsLocations
options.description:
Allows you to get the locations for crafting tools/weapons/armors by obtaining them through other means
(Looting chests, buying from woodmen...)

options.name: logicDifficulty
options.description:
Only used in logic to determine how many powerups/weapons/armors you need to defeat bosses
Will cause generation errors when using a low difficulty and a small item pool

Easy will wait until you have a LOT of powerups and weapons before saying you can fight bosses
None will assume you can beat everything with nothing but a rock
Normal and Hard are in-betweens

It is NOT recommended to play with None

options.name: deathlink
options.description: Include deathlink

options.name: local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: non_local_items
options.description: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: start_inventory
options.description: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: "Bomb: 1"

options.name: start_hints
options.description: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: start_location_hints
options.description: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

options.name: exclude_locations
options.description: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

options.name: priority_locations
options.description: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.

options.name: item_links
options.description: Share part of your item pool with other players.
